message:
feat(desktop): audition + follow play the detected swing feel (#156) (#159)

Verovio's renderToTimemap ignores <sound><swing> (verified: identical tstamps), so a score marked Swing auditioned with straight eighths.

buildSwingWarp rebuilds the written->sounding map from the canonical payload (swingFeel phase + tempoMap + head meter; primary-beat bpm per #157) and shifts each beat's second half onto the detected phase; beat onsets, measure ends and duration are fixed points. buildPlaybackTable applies the warp to every tstamp so segments, onsets and the cursor clock all land on sounding time.

Co-authored-by: Devin <158243242+devin-ai-integration[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>
